era: 1332 年生于突尼斯一个安达卢西亚移民的显赫世家——祖上随半岛的征服而来，家族在塞维利亚与突尼斯官居高位；1349 年黑死病夺去他的双亲——那场大疫正被他后来写进《殷鉴书》的序论，作为人口与文明涨落的证词；在突尼斯马格里布学院受传统的法学与神学训练，二十岁即入哈夫斯王朝宫廷为秘书；此后二十年在马格里布诸王朝的宫廷与政局中沉浮——为斐兹的马里尼王朝起草国书，被格拉纳达的穆罕默德五世延为重臣，1366 年受命出使卡斯蒂利亚的残酷者佩德罗；1375 年退隐阿尔及利亚的伊本·萨拉玛城堡——四年时间写成《历史绪论》(Muqaddimah) 的初稿；1382 年赴埃及开罗，任马立克派大法官（卡迪），六度任免，宦海再起；1401 年在大马士革城外与围城的帖木儿帐中夜谈三十五日——留下的自传是那次对话的中介文本；1406 年逝于开罗。《殷鉴书》(Kitab al-'Ibar) 全书七卷，绪论一卷独立成典
era_en: Born 1332 in Tunis into a distinguished family of Andalusian exiles — ancestors come with the conquest from the peninsula, the house holding high office in Seville and Tunis; in 1349 the Black Death took both his parents — that plague later written into the Muqaddimah's opening as testimony of population and civilisation's rise and fall; trained in the traditional legal and theological curriculum of the Maghribi madrasas, entering the Hafsid court as secretary at twenty; twenty years thereafter adrift among the courts and politics of the Maghrib's dynasties — drafting state letters for the Marinids of Fez, taken into the confidence of Muhammad V of Granada, sent in 1366 as envoy to Pedro the Cruel of Castile; in 1375 retiring to the castle of Ibn Salama in Algeria — four years writing the first draft of the Muqaddimah; to Cairo in 1382, grand Maliki qadi under the Mamluks, six times appointed and dismissed, in office again; in 1401 outside Damascus thirty-five nights of conversation in Tamerlane's besieging camp — the autobiography the intermediary text of that colloquy; died in Cairo, 1406. The Kitab al-'Ibar in seven volumes, the Muqaddimah standing alone as its prolegomenon
school: 历史哲学奠基 / 社会科学先驱 / 马立克学派法学家 / 马格里布-埃及宫廷政治亲历者
historical_significance: 他在十四世纪发明了一门尚无名字的科学——'人的社会的科学'(ilm al-'umran al-bashari)：《历史绪论》第一部分不是历史而是历史的方法论——传世史书里遍地的荒诞与夸大需要一套检验标准；他第一个追问'为什么王朝会灭亡'并给出结构答案：阿萨比亚（群体凝聚力）的涨落是政权的引擎与墓志——游牧民族以强悍的凝聚力征服，定居的奢侈三代之内腐蚀它，王朝因此有生命曲线；他把经济纳入兴衰的机制——税收先轻后重、市场先盛后衰、奢侈先荣后亡——四百年后孟德斯鸠与吉本以欧洲的语言重新发现他；他区分'表面意义'与'内在意义'——历史记录须按政治环境、风俗习惯的可能性行普遍性检验——这是历史批判方法最早的全套陈述；涂尔干称为社会学的先驱，汤因比称《绪论》是'迄今问世的任何时代任何国家的史学著作中最伟大的一部'
historical_significance_en: In the fourteenth century he invented a science that yet had no name — the science of human society (ilm al-'umran al-bashari): the first part of the Muqaddimah is not history but the methodology of history — the multitudinous absurdities and exaggerations of the received chronicles demand a canonic of testing; the first to ask 'why do dynasties fall' and to answer structurally: the ebb and flow of 'asabiyya (group cohesion) is the engine and the epitaph of regimes — nomads conquer by a strong cohesion, sedentary luxury corrodes it within three generations, and dynasties therefore have a life-curve; he built the economy into the mechanism of rise and fall — taxes light then heavy, markets flourishing then failing, luxury first glory then ruin — Montesquieu and Gibbon rediscovering him four centuries later in a European tongue; he distinguished 'apparent meaning' from 'inner meaning' — historical reports to be tested for universality against political circumstance and the customarily possible — the earliest full statement of the historical-critical method; Durkheim named him a forerunner of sociology, Toynbee called the Muqaddimah 'the greatest work of its kind that has ever yet been created by any mind in any time or place'
unique_thinking: 伊本·赫勒敦的思维内核是'把人的群体当作自然现象来研究'：王朝与文明的兴衰不是道德剧而是有规律的过程——如同生物有其生老病死；第二个内核是'结构先于个人'：王朝的命运系于阿萨比亚（群体凝聚力）而非君主的贤愚——个体行为须放回群体结构中解释，这比社会学学科早五百年；第三个内核是'周期律'：王朝三至四代而衰——第一代以游牧的艰辛保住凝聚力，第二代以征服者自居而始享安逸，第三代忘却艰辛全然奢侈——凝聚力一代薄于一代；第四个内核是'经济-政治互动'：王朝规模决定赋税需求，赋税先增后竭，市场随治安与币值而荣枯——'王朝的奢侈磨损它的尚武'；第五个内核是'批判的普遍性检验'：史料记载须检验其是否违反事物的普遍可能性——'内在意义'重于'表面意义'
unique_thinking_en: Ibn Khaldun's cognitive core is to study human collectivities as natural phenomena: the rise and fall of dynasties and civilisations not a moral drama but a law-governed process — as living things have their age and decay; the second core, structure before persons: a dynasty's fate hangs on 'asabiyya, group cohesion, not the ruler's virtue or folly — individual acts to be explained within group structure, five hundred years ahead of sociology as a discipline; the third, the cycle: dynasties decay within three or four generations — the first holding cohesion in nomadic hardship, the second dwelling as conquerors and beginning at ease, the third forgetting hardship wholly in luxury — cohesion thinning generation by generation; the fourth, the economic-political interlock: a dynasty's scale sets its tax demand, taxes first rising then choking, markets waxing with security and sound coin and waning with both — 'luxury wears away a dynasty's martial virtue'; the fifth, critical universality testing: received reports to be checked against the general possibility of things — 'inner meaning' before 'apparent meaning'
civilization_zh: 十四世纪的马格里布与埃及：安达卢西亚陷落后穆斯林西迁的浪潮——他的家族是其中一叶；黑死病（1347-1351）横扫地中海世界，马格里布人口凋敝、王朝更迭——他亲历了'文明衰败'的原材料；马格里布诸王朝（哈夫斯、马里尼、齐亚尼德）相互攻伐，宫廷是学者的雇主也是学者的刑场——他两度下狱、一度几乎丧命；格拉纳达的纳斯里王朝是穆斯林伊比利亚的余晖——他在其中看到定居文明晚期的从容与脆弱；开罗的马穆鲁克王朝是当时伊斯兰世界最繁华的都市文明——他的晚年大法官生涯在其中有观测一个成熟定居王朝的位置；《绪论》写成于游牧部落（贝都因人、柏柏尔人、后期的帖木儿）仍是地中海南岸现实军事力量的时代——'游牧与定居'是那个世纪的知识分子每天看见的事实
civilization_en: The Maghrib and Egypt of the fourteenth century: the westward tide of Muslim exiles after Andalusia's fall — his family one leaf of it; the Black Death (1347-1351) sweeping the Mediterranean world, the Maghrib depopulated, dynasties succeeding one another — the raw material of 'decline' seen at first hand; the Maghribi dynasties (Hafsids, Marinids, Ziyanids) warring each upon the other, the court at once the scholar's employer and his place of execution — twice imprisoned, once near death; Granada's Nasrid kingdom the afterglow of Muslim Iberia — the late composure and fragility of a sedentary civilisation seen within it; Mamluk Cairo the densest urban civilisation of the Islamic world — his late years as qadi giving him a vantage on a mature sedentary dynasty; the Muqaddimah written in an age when tribal peoples (Bedouin, Berbers, later Tamerlane) were still the live military force of the Mediterranean's southern shore — nomad and sedentary a fact the century's intelligentsia saw daily
roles_zh: 历史哲学家（《历史绪论》的作者——一门尚无名字的科学的立法者）；国家大臣与外交使节（马格里布诸宫廷与格拉纳达、卡斯蒂利亚之间——政治的亲历者）；马立克派大法官（开罗六度任免——教法与行政的两栖）；自传作者（《自传》是前现代世界最详尽的自我记述之一）；宫廷教师（帖木儿帐中夜谈的对话者）
roles_en: Philosopher of history (author of the Muqaddimah — the lawgiver of a science that had no name yet); statesman and envoy (between the Maghribi courts and Granada, Castile — a firsthand witness of politics); Maliki grand qadi (six appointments and dismissals in Cairo — amphibious in law and administration); autobiographer (his Autobiography among the fullest self-accounts of the premodern world); court teacher (the interlocutor of the night colloquy in Tamerlane's camp)
key_works: 《历史绪论》(Muqaddimah, 1377 初稿)——人的社会的科学总纲：阿萨比亚、王朝周期、经济兴衰、历史批判
《殷鉴书》(Kitab al-'Ibar, 全书七卷)——世界通史正文，绪论之外的案例库
《自传》(al-Ta'rif bi-Ibn Khaldun)——前现代最详尽的自我记述，含与帖木儿夜谈的记录
key_concepts: 阿萨比亚 'asabiyya（群体凝聚力——政权的真正资本，游牧最强而定居渐蚀）
王朝周期 dawla cycle（王朝如生物有寿命——三至四代由兴而衰）
人的社会的科学 'ilm al-'umran al-bashari（他为其命名的新学科——社会规律可作科学研究）
游牧/定居 badawa/hadara（两种文明形态及其相互转化的引擎）

奢侈与衰败（定居的富足腐蚀凝聚力——'奢侈磨损尚武'）

modes.domain_zh: 政权分析/把政权兴衰追溯到群体凝聚力这一结构变量而非统治者个人品质
modes.domain_en: Analysis of regimes / tracing rise and fall to group cohesion as the structural variable, not the ruler's personal qualities
modes.definition_zh: 政治社会方法论/《历史绪论》的核心概念：政权不是靠君主的贤愚维持的，而是靠'阿萨比亚'（'asabiyya）——一个群体成员之间基于血缘、患难与共同敌人而生的凝聚力；凝聚力强，散沙可成军、荒野可成国；凝聚力衰，虽名城巨室不能守；因此分析任何政权的第一问题不是'统治者是谁'而是'统治群体的凝聚力从哪来、在涨还是在消'——个体行为放回群体结构中解释，这是把政治从道德剧改写为结构分析的奠基一跃
modes.definition_en: Analysis of regimes / the central concept of the Muqaddimah: a regime is not held up by the ruler's wisdom or folly but by 'asabiyya — the cohesion binding a group's members by blood, shared hardship and common enemies; while cohesion is strong, loose sand becomes an army and wilderness a state; when it wanes, no walled city or great house can be held; the first question for any regime is therefore not 'who rules' but 'whence does the ruling group's cohesion come, and is it rising or ebbing' — individual conduct explained by placement in group structure, the founding leap that rewrites politics from moral drama into structural analysis
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第二、三章：阿萨比亚作为王朝兴起与存续的'自然而必需的条件'
modes.key_quote_zh: 王朝的存亡不在君主的贤愚，而在统治群体凝聚力的涨落——先问结构，再问个人。
modes.key_quote_en: A dynasty's life and death lie not in the ruler's virtue but in the ebb and flow of the ruling group's cohesion — structure first, persons after.
key_concepts: 群体凝聚力 'asabiyya（血缘、患难、共同敌人三源——可积累也可耗散的结构资本）
group cohesion (three sources — blood, shared hardship, common enemies — structural capital to be accumulated or spent)
结构先于个人（统治者是凝聚力的执行者而非来源——个人崇拜是误诊）
structure before persons (the ruler cohesion's executor, not its source — personality cults a misdiagnosis)
凝聚力的耗散（胜利带来定居、定居带来安逸、安逸蚀凝聚力——过程可测）
cohesion erosion (victory brings settlement, settlement ease, ease corrodes cohesion — a measurable course)
凝聚力与合法性（政权强弱实为群体向心力的外部投影）
cohesion and legitimacy (a regime's strength the outward projection of inward solidarity)
process_zh: 识别统治群体：先画出真正掌权的群体边界——不问职位表，问谁的实际支持构成政权
测凝聚力的来源与存量：血缘纽带？共同患难？外部威胁？——逐项评估其当下的强度
判断走向：凝聚力的来源在积累还是在耗散——胜利与安逸是耗散项，患难与外敌是积累项
按结构下注：预测与干预都按凝聚力走向设计——而非按领导人的言辞与人事更迭
process_en: Identify the ruling group: map who actually holds power — not the org chart, but whose actual support constitutes the regime
Gauge cohesion's sources and stock: kinship bonds? shared hardship? external threat? — assess each's present strength
Judge direction: are cohesion's sources accumulating or eroding — victory and ease erode; hardship and a common foe accumulate
Bet on structure: predictions and interventions designed by cohesion's course, not by the leader's words or personnel changes
representative_cases_zh: 投资人评估一家公司不看创始人的演讲而看'联合创始团队还剩几人在、股权是否还完整'——创业公司真正的阿萨比亚是核心团队向心力，散伙先于失败
收购整合中咨询公司建议'先保留被购方的老班底两年'——外部品牌的凝聚力融入需要共同患难，强行空降管理者等于摧毁对方的凝聚力存量
社团招新时老成员发现'人数涨了向心力降了'——按阿萨比亚法把新成员先编入共同做事的小组（制造患难）而非只拉进大群（只制造名义成员）
representative_cases_en: An investor reading a startup not by the founder's pitch but by how many co-founders remain and whether equity still holds — the venture's true 'asabiyya is core-team cohesion, and dissolution precedes failure

In an acquisition, advisers propose keeping the acquired firm's old guard two years — a new brand's cohesion needs shared hardship to fuse, and parachuting in managers spends the target's stock of solidarity

A club's veterans notice headcount up but loyalty down — by the asabiyya method they route newcomers into small teams doing real work together (manufacturing shared hardship) rather than merely adding them to the big group (nominal members only)
representative_figures: 伊本·赫勒敦
阿萨比亚概念的立法者——把政权兴衰归结为群体凝聚力的结构变量
马基雅维利
《君主论》同样拒绝道德化解释政治——但以'命运与武德'而非凝聚力为变量
涂尔干
《社会分工论》以机械团结/有机团结测量群体纽带——结构先于个人的同源纲领
modern_applications_zh: 投资尽调：判断早期公司不看创始人演讲而看核心团队向心力（共同患难年数、期权兑现记录）——凝聚力先于商业模式
并购整合：保留被购方老班底共担一个新项目再融合——强行空降管理者等于摧毁对方的凝聚力存量
组织诊断：'留人难'问题先测凝聚力来源（血缘式信任/共同患难/外部对手）在积累还是耗散，而非只加薪
modern_applications_en: Due diligence: judge an early company not by the founder's pitch but by the core team's cohesion (years of shared hardship, option-vesting record) — cohesion before business model
M&A integration: keep the acquired firm's old guard together on one new project before fusing — parachuting in managers spends the target's stock of solidarity
Organisational diagnosis: on 'talent bleeding', first test whether cohesion's sources are accumulating or eroding — not simply raise pay

modes.domain_zh: 文明分析/把文明与王朝当作有生命周期的自然现象——兴衰不是道德堕落而是结构必然
modes.domain_en: Civilisational analysis / treating civilisations and dynasties as natural phenomena with life-spans — decline not moral backsliding but structural necessity
modes.definition_zh: 历史哲学方法论/《绪论》的总纲：'王朝有如人的自然寿命'——文明体有生老病死，且周期的各阶段有可辨识的症状（人口、税基、市场、风尚）；因此'衰落'不是道德故事（末代君主必然昏庸），而是结构过程（凝聚力的代际耗散必然发生，与君主个人无关）；把文明当自然现象研究意味着：可以观察症状、定位阶段、预测走向——历史从道德教训库变成可作规律研究的对象，这是一门尚无名字的科学('ilm al-'umran)的成立宣言
modes.definition_en: Philosophy-of-history methodology / the Muqaddimah's master frame: 'dynasties have a natural life-span like persons' — civilisational bodies age and die, and the cycle's stages have identifiable symptoms (population, tax base, markets, manners); decline is therefore not a moral tale (the last ruler necessarily corrupt) but a structural process (cohesion's intergenerational erosion happens regardless of the ruler); to study civilisation as natural phenomena means symptoms can be observed, stages located, courses projected — history turning from a storehouse of moral lessons into an object for law-like study, the founding charter of a science that yet had no name (ilm al-'umran)
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第二章第二节：'王朝有如人的自然寿命'——周期律的生物学隐喻
modes.key_quote_zh: 王朝有如人，有其自然的寿数——衰亡不是道德的堕落，而是结构的必然。
modes.key_quote_en: Dynasties have a natural life-span like persons — decline not moral corruption but structural necessity.
key_concepts: 文明生命周期（兴—盛—衰三段各有症状——人口/税基/市场/风尚为指标）
civilisational life-cycle (rise, maturity, decline, each with symptoms — population, tax base, markets, manners as indices)
反道德化解释（末代君主非必昏庸——换任何人接手都在同一曲线上）
anti-moralisation (last rulers not necessarily vicious — anyone inheriting sits on the same curve)
症状观察法（从可测指标反推文明所处的阶段）
symptom reading (inferring the civilisation's stage from measurable indices)
周期的可预测性（知阶段即知走向——预测而非叹息）
cycle predictability (to know the stage is to know the course — projection, not lament)
process_zh: 拒绝道德叙事：遇到'衰败'话题，先删除'昏君/奸臣'的归因——问结构变量
采集症状：收集人口、税基、市场规模、社会风尚等可测指标——不凭印象定阶段
定位周期阶段：症状集匹配兴/盛/衰哪一段——并核对指标间的一致性（如税基升而人口降为矛盾信号）
按阶段行动：兴段扩张、盛段巩固、衰段止损——把战略选择与周期位置挂钩
process_en: Refuse the moral narrative: on 'decline', first delete the attribution to tyrants and traitors — ask the structural variables
Gather symptoms: collect measurable indices — population, tax base, market size, social manners; fix no stage by impression
Locate the stage: match the symptom set to rise, maturity or decline — and check consistency across indices (tax base up while population down is a contradictory signal)
Act by stage: expand in rise, consolidate at maturity, cut losses in decline — strategy tied to the cycle's position
representative_cases_zh: 行业分析师判断'某传统零售巨头不行了'不引用管理层丑闻，而是看同店客流、租金占比、供应链账期三指标——三指标同向向下即定位衰段，个人是否昏庸无关曲线
开源社区维护者评估项目兴衰不看 star 数而看核心提交者数量、issue 响应时长、新人合并率——症状一致才下'项目进入衰段'的判断并提前分叉
非营利组织理事会在捐赠下滑时拒绝'秘书长不行就换人'的直觉——按周期法先看捐赠人结构、项目口碑、志愿者留存三症状，发现是行业性周期而非机构性失败，选择收缩战线而非换血
representative_cases_en: An analyst judging 'that retail giant is finished' cites no management scandal but three indices — same-store traffic, rent share, supplier terms; all three down together locates the decline stage, and whoever sits in the corner office is beside the curve
An open-source maintainer gauges a project not by stars but by core committers, issue response time and newcomer merge rate — symptoms agreeing, he declares the decline stage and forks early

A nonprofit board facing falling donations resists the reflex to replace the executive director — by the cycle method they first read donor mix, programme reputation, volunteer retention; finding an industry-wide cycle rather than institutional failure, they retrench instead of reblood

modern_applications_zh: 行业分析：判断'某巨头不行了'不引丑闻而看同店客流、租金占比、账期三指标——症状一致才定位衰段
开源维护：项目兴衰看核心提交者数、issue 响应时长、新人合并率——提前识别衰段并分叉
战略规划：把扩张/巩固/止损决策与周期位置挂钩，而非与管理者个人风格挂钩
modern_applications_en: Industry analysis: judge 'that giant is finished' not by scandal but by same-store traffic, rent share, supplier terms — symptoms agreeing locates the decline stage
Open-source stewardship: read a project's health in core committers, issue response time, newcomer merge rate — spot the decline stage and fork early
Strategy: tie expansion, consolidation and retrenchment to the cycle's position, not to the manager's personal style

modes.domain_zh: 组织传承分析/用代际视角预判组织气质与制度能力的漂移——一代创业、二代守成、三代忘本
modes.domain_en: Organisational succession analysis / predicting drift of an organisation's temper and institutional capacity across generations — the founders build, the second keep, the third forget
modes.definition_zh: 历史哲学方法论/《绪论》的周期操作化：王朝在其第三或第四代失去元气——第一代与创业一代共享游牧的艰辛，凝聚力因患难而强，他们知道每项制度'为什么存在'；第二代以征服者后裔自居，脱离艰辛而接手安逸，制度开始从'必要'变为'惯例'；第三代生于富贵，全然不知艰辛为何物，问'为什么不能这样做'——凝聚力由实感退化为仪式；关键洞见是漂移发生在代际而非个人：任何一代的成员都无法凭意志保住他们从未经历过的东西——传承的本质是经历不可传递，制度必须为不可传递性设计
modes.definition_en: Philosophy-of-history methodology / the cycle operationalised: a dynasty loses its temper in the third or fourth generation — the founding generation shares nomadic hardship, cohesion strong with shared ordeal, and they know why each institution exists; the second, reared as conquerors' heirs, exchange hardship for ease, and institutions pass from 'necessary' to 'customary'; the third born in opulence, never knowing hardship, asks 'why may we not do so' — cohesion thinned from lived reality into ritual; the key insight is that drift happens across generations, not persons: no generation can by will retain what it never lived through — succession's essence is that experience cannot be transmitted, and institutions must be designed for that untransmissibility
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第二章第五节：'王朝之衰不在第四代之后'——代际稀释的经验规律
modes.key_quote_zh: 第一代知其所以然，第二代视为惯例，第三代问'为什么不能'——经历不可传递，制度必须为此设计。
modes.key_quote_en: The first generation knows why; the second holds it custom; the third asks 'why not' — experience cannot be handed down, and institutions must be designed for that.
key_concepts: 代际稀释（凝聚力与制度理解力随代际递减——每代只能继承解释而非体验）
generational dilution (cohesion and institutional understanding thinning by generation — each inherits explanation, not experience)
艰辛的不可传递（创业者讲得再动人也造不出下一代的患难记忆）
the untransmissible hardship (founders' stories, however vivid, cannot manufacture the next generation's memory of ordeal)
制度仪式化（'为什么存在'失传后制度只剩动作——遵守而不理解）
ritualisation (once 'why it exists' is lost, institutions are only motions — observed, not understood)
三代之数（三或四代——非精确预言而是稀释速率的数量级）
the count of three (three or four generations — not exact prophecy but the order of magnitude of dilution)
process_zh: 数代际：把组织按'共同经历'而非工龄分层——经历过大患难的是一代，听故事长大的是二代
测理解力：随机抽问'这个制度为什么存在'——答得出'为什么'的是一代思维，答'一直这样做'的是三代征兆
造患难：把关键决策、客户危机、一线轮岗有意安排给二代三代——用真实经历补稀释
为不可传递设计：把'为什么'写进制度文档并设复审机制——默认每五年会有人问'为什么不能'
process_en: Count generations: stratify the organisation by shared experience, not tenure — those who lived the founding ordeal are the first, those raised on its stories the second
Test understanding: at random ask 'why does this institution exist' — 'why' answers are first-generation thinking; 'we've always done it' is third-generation sign
Manufacture hardship: deliberately route key decisions, customer crises, front-line rotations to the second and third — patch dilution with lived experience
Design for the untransmissible: write the 'why' into institutional documents with mandatory re-review — assume someone will ask 'why not' every five years
representative_cases_zh: 家族企业二代接班后砍掉'低效'的老规矩，利润反降——顾问按三世代法诊断：砍掉的不是低效而是患难记忆（老规矩是创始人对某次具体灾难的回应）；处置方案是让二代先做一年一线再动制度
开源项目创始人退休后维护者渐失'为何这个接口如此怪'的知识——按三世代法在 ADR（架构决策记录）里强制写'当时拒绝的备选方案与理由'，而非只留结论
创业公司上市后老员工发现新人'不理解为什么我们要全量灰度发布'——按三世代法不办宣讲会而把新人编入一次真实故障复盘——制度理解只能靠经历重建
representative_cases_en: A family firm's second generation cuts the 'inefficient' old rules and profits fall — consultants diagnose by three generations: what was cut was not inefficiency but the memory of ordeal (the rules were a founder's answer to one specific catastrophe); the remedy: a year on the front line before touching institutions

After an open-source founder retires, maintainers lose the knowledge of 'why this interface is so odd' — by the method, ADRs must record the rejected alternatives and their reasons, not just conclusions

In a post-IPO startup veterans hear newcomers ask 'why must we do full canary releases' — by the method, no lecture halls but seating newcomers in one real incident post-mortem — institutional understanding rebuilt only through experience
representative_figures: 伊本·赫勒敦
三代之律的立法者——把王朝寿命归为代际稀释的经验规律
曾国藩
家训中的'由俭入奢易'——对代际漂移的东方同题观察
司马光
《训俭示康》——'俭则寡欲，奢则多欲'的代际防腐设计
modern_applications_zh: 传承管理：随机抽问'这个制度为什么存在'——答'一直这样做'即三代漂移征兆，需安排一线经历补稀释
决策文档：ADR 强制写'当时拒绝的备选方案与理由'而非只留结论——为经历不可传递做文档化补偿
接班安排：接班人先做一年一线再动制度——制度理解只能靠经历重建，宣讲会无效
modern_applications_en: Succession management: at random ask 'why does this institution exist' — 'we've always done it' is third-generation drift; route real front-line experience to patch dilution
Decision records: ADRs must record rejected alternatives and their reasons, not just conclusions — document-based compensation for untransmissible experience
Succession plans: successors spend a year on the front line before touching institutions — understanding rebuilt only through experience, not lectures

modes.domain_zh: 组织形态分析/用'游牧-定居'两极模型诊断群体在进取与安逸之间的位置及相互转化
modes.domain_en: Analysis of organisational form / a nomad-sedentary polar model diagnosing where a group sits between drive and ease, and how the two convert
modes.definition_zh: 文明结构方法论/《绪论》的形态学：人类群体在两种形态间摆动——游牧（badawa）以艰辛、尚武、互助、简朴为特征，凝聚力高而物质匮乏；定居（hadara）以安逸、奢侈、分工、享乐为特征，物质丰裕而凝聚力低；关键在两者的辩证关系：征服把游牧变成定居的新主人，而定居生活逐代腐蚀其游牧品质，直到被新的游牧者征服——循环不息；这不是道德判断（定居不'更坏'）而是结构诊断（两种形态各有其能与不能）——识别一个群体当前在哪极、正在向哪极滑动，是判断其能做什么的第一步
modes.definition_en: Methodology of civilisational structure / the Muqaddimah's morphology: human groups swing between two forms — nomadism (badawa) marked by hardship, martial virtue, mutual aid and simplicity, high cohesion and material scarcity; sedentary life (hadara) marked by ease, luxury, division of labour and pleasure, material plenty and low cohesion; the crux is their dialectic: conquest makes nomads the new masters of sedentary life, and sedentary living corrodes their nomad qualities generation by generation, until new nomads conquer — a wheel without end; this is not moral judgement (the sedentary are not 'worse') but structural diagnosis (each form can and cannot do different things) — identifying where a group now sits, and toward which pole it slides, is the first step in judging what it can accomplish
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第二、五、六章：游牧社会与定居社会的对照及其相互转化
modes.key_quote_zh: 游牧以其强悍征服定居，定居以其安逸腐蚀游牧——识别自己在哪一极、正滑向哪一极。
modes.key_quote_en: The nomad conquers the sedentary by his hardness; the sedentary corrodes the nomad by his ease — know which pole you occupy and toward which you slide.
key_concepts: 两极形态（游牧=艰辛+凝聚力+尚武；定居=丰裕+分工+凝聚力低）
two poles (nomad = hardship + cohesion + martial virtue; sedentary = plenty + division of labour + low cohesion)
转化的引擎（征服把游牧变定居的主人；安逸把主人变被征服者）
the engine of conversion (conquest seats nomads as masters of sedentary life; ease unseats them)
非道德化（两极各有其能与不能——诊断而非褒贬）
non-moralisation (each pole can and cannot do different things — diagnosis, not praise or blame)
滑动方向判断（安逸指标升、患难指标降即正在滑向定居极）
reading the slide (ease indices rising, hardship indices falling — sliding sedentary)
process_zh: 建立两极坐标：列出'进取/安逸'的行为指标（冒险投入/流程舒适、患难共担/部门本位）
测量当前位置：逐指标打分——群体此刻更像游牧还是定居
判断滑动方向与速度：与一两年前对比——安逸指标是否在稳定上升
按位置选策略：游牧端该拼业务别乱立规矩（过度的流程会杀死进取），定居端该立规矩别指望热血（奢侈期靠制度而非士气）
process_en: Set the polar coordinates: list behavioural indices of drive and ease (risk investment vs procedural comfort, shared ordeal vs departmental silos)
Measure present position: score each index — nomad or sedentary now?
Judge direction and speed: against one or two years ago — are ease indices steadily rising?

Choose strategy by position: at the nomad pole, chase the work and resist premature process (excess process kills drive); at the sedentary pole, build institutions and stop hoping for fervour (in luxury, rely on systems, not morale)
representative_cases_zh: 创业公司融资后讨论'要不要引入大厂流程'——按两极法判断：刚过生存线的团队仍在游牧端，过早流程化会杀死尚武精神；结论是只立与安全相关的最低流程，其余等定居化加深再说
成熟企业想'找回创业精神'，先按两极法测位置：员工指标显示全公司已在定居端（流程完备、风险厌恶）——此时'喊口号'无效，正确工具是设立独立于主流程的特种小队（人造游牧飞地）
开源社区讨论'是否引入企业级治理'——按两极法识别出贡献者主体仍是游牧形态（自发、无 KPI、周末驱动），强推企业流程会驱逐现有凝聚力——治理按最小化设计
representative_cases_en: A funded startup debates 'adopting big-firm process' — by the polar method: a team just past survival still sits at the nomad pole; premature process kills the martial spirit; only minimum safety-critical process now, the rest when sedentarisation deepens

A mature company wanting 'the startup spirit back' first measures its position: every index shows full sedentary polarity (complete process, risk aversion) — slogans useless; the right tool is a special unit run outside the main process, a manufactured nomad enclave

An open-source community debates 'enterprise-grade governance' — the polar method identifies the contributors as still nomadic (voluntary, no KPIs, weekend-driven); forcing corporate process would evict the existing cohesion — governance kept minimal
representative_figures: 伊本·赫勒敦
游牧-定居两极模型的立法者——形态学而非道德学
汤因比
挑战-应答模型——逆境（游牧的艰辛）作为文明动力的同构
斯宾格勒
《西方的没落》——文明形态学的四季比喻
modern_applications_zh: 流程设计：游牧期（刚过生存线）只立安全相关的最低流程——过早流程化杀死进取；定居期靠制度不靠士气
创新机制：成熟组织'找回创业精神'不喊口号而设独立于主流程的特种小队——人造游牧飞地
社区治理：识别贡献者主体形态（自发 vs 职业化）再定治理强度——强推企业流程会驱逐现有凝聚力
modern_applications_en: Process design: at the nomad stage (just past survival) only minimum safety-critical process — premature process kills drive; at the sedentary stage rely on institutions, not morale
Innovation mechanisms: mature organisations recover 'the startup spirit' not by slogans but by a special unit outside the main process — a manufactured nomad enclave
Community governance: identify the contributors' form (voluntary vs professionalised) before setting governance strength — forcing corporate process evicts existing cohesion

modes.domain_zh: 财政分析/把财政轨迹当作政权生命周期的温度计——低税率高总额为盛，高税率低总额为衰
modes.domain_en: Fiscal analysis / the fiscal trajectory as a thermometer of a regime's life-cycle — low rates with high yield for maturity, high rates with low yield for decline
modes.definition_zh: 财政经济方法论/《绪论》最著名的经济命题：王朝初立税轻而民安，市场繁荣使税基扩大——总额随低税率而增；王朝中期开支膨胀，税率先加，最初总额仍增；但越过临界点后，高税率摧毁生产激励，商人歇业、田亩抛荒——税基收缩使总额反降；统治者见总额下降更急于加税，遂成恶性循环：'王朝衰则税重，税重则王朝愈衰'；这一'税率与总额的倒 U 关系'是他从北非税政的亲历中归纳的——比拉弗曲线早六百年，且不只是一种理论，而是把财政轨迹当作政权生命周期的温度计来读
modes.definition_en: Fiscal-economic methodology / the Muqaddimah's most famous economic thesis: a young dynasty taxes lightly and the people thrive — markets widen the base, and the yield grows with low rates; mid-life, expenses swell and rates rise, the yield at first still growing; but past the critical point high rates destroy the incentive to produce — merchants close shop, fields go untilled — the base shrinks and yield falls; seeing the yield fall, the ruler taxes harder still, a spiral: 'a dynasty in decline taxes heavily, and heavy taxation declines it further'; this inverted-U of rate and yield, generalised from his firsthand knowledge of Maghribi fiscality, anticipates the Laffer curve by six centuries — and is more than a theory: the fiscal trajectory read as the thermometer of a regime's life-cycle
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第三章第一至二节：'税收在王朝初期轻而在末期重'及其后果
modes.key_quote_zh: 王朝衰则税重，税重则王朝愈衰——税率与总额的倒 U 曲线，是政权的温度计。
modes.key_quote_en: A declining dynasty taxes heavily, and heavy taxation declines it further — the inverted U of rate and yield, the regime's thermometer.
key_concepts: 倒 U 曲线（税率与税收总额的关系先正后负——临界点即盛衰转折）
the inverted U (rate to yield first positive then negative — the critical point the turn of the cycle)
税基-税率之辨（总额下降时应查税基而非加税率——激励的破坏先于账面）
base versus rate (falling yield demands inspecting the base, not raising rates — incentive destruction precedes the ledger)
财政作为温度计（财政轨迹是政权生命周期的可读指标）
fiscal thermometer (the fiscal trajectory a readable index of the regime's life-cycle)
恶性循环（总额降→加税→税基缩→总额再降——越挣扎越沉）
the doom loop (yield falls, rates rise, base shrinks, yield falls again — the harder the struggle the deeper the sink)
process_zh: 画出财政轨迹：不只看总额，把'税率水平'与'税基规模'分开成两条曲线
定位曲线位置：总额与税率同向升为健康（左半支）；总额降而税率升为警戒（已过临界点）
诊断税基：总额下降时追问——参与者/活跃度在退出吗？激励被破坏了吗？
反直觉操作：临界点后唯一解是减税养基——尽管这在短期内意味着财政更紧
process_en: Draw the fiscal trajectory: not yield alone but two curves — rate level and base size, separately
Locate the position: yield and rate rising together healthy (left limb); yield falling while rate rising the alarm (past the critical point)
Diagnose the base: when yield falls, ask — are participants or activity exiting? has incentive been destroyed?
The counter-intuitive move: past the point the only cure is cutting rates to rebuild the base — however tighter it makes the short term
representative_cases_zh: 平台提高抽成后 GMV 反降，财务主张再提价补差额——按税收曲线法诊断：总额降而费率升即已过临界点，再加价只会加速商家退出；正确动作是降费促活，尽管短期收入更难看
开源软件公司从免费转收费后用户与贡献双降——按税收曲线法识别：'税'（收费墙）已破坏生态税基，回撤为'核心免费+企业增值'以养基
项目管理中把人力抽调率从 30% 提到 50% 后交付反而更慢——按税收曲线法识别激励倒 U：抽调率超过临界点后团队进入'应付模式'，回落到 35% 后交付恢复
representative_cases_en: A platform raises its commission and GMV falls; finance proposes raising again to cover the gap — by the tax-curve method: yield down while rate up means past the critical point; another rise only hastens merchant exit; the move is to cut rates to rebuild the base, however worse the short term

An open-core firm turns its free product paid and both users and contributions fall — by the method, the 'tax' (the paywall) has destroyed the ecological base; it retreats to 'core free + enterprise extras' to regrow it

A project lifts its extraction rate of engineers from 30% to 50% and delivery slows — by the method, the incentive inverted-U: past the critical point teams go into compliance mode; back to 35%, delivery recovers
representative_figures: 伊本·赫勒敦
税率-总额倒 U 曲线的最早陈述——财政即政权温度计
黄宗羲
《明夷待访录·田制》的财税总账——'积累莫返之害'的东方同题
拉弗
拉弗曲线——六百年后的经济学再发现
modern_applications_zh: 平台定价：抽成提高后 GMV 反降时先查税基（商家退出）而非再加价——费率-总额的倒 U 临界点后唯一解是降费促活
开源商业化：收费墙破坏生态税基时回撤为'核心免费+企业增值'——先养基后取税
资源管理：人力抽调率超过临界点后团队进入应付模式——把抽调率当税率管理，画倒 U 曲线找最优区间
modern_applications_en: Platform pricing: when commission rises and GMV falls, inspect the base (merchant exit) before raising again — past the inverted-U's critical point the only cure is cutting rates to rebuild
Open-source commercialisation: when a paywall destroys the ecological base, retreat to 'core free + enterprise extras' — grow the base before taxing it
Resource management: past the critical extraction rate teams go into compliance mode — manage the extraction rate like a tax rate, drawing the inverted U for the optimum band

modes.domain_zh: 史料检验/以'表面意义/内在意义'之辨与普遍可能性检验传世史料的可信度
modes.domain_en: Source criticism / testing received historical reports via the distinction of apparent and inner meaning and the canonic of general possibility
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/《绪论》第一部分的主题：传世史书满是不可信的记载——夸大的军数、荒诞的传闻、抄自前书的讹误；他提出系统的检验法：一辨'表面意义'（文本字面说了什么）与'内在意义'（记载在当时的政治、社会、心理条件下是否可能为真）；二用'普遍可能性'作尺——孤例若违反事物的普遍规律（如徒手一夜筑城）则不可采信，无论传述链条多么显赫；三考察传述者与记录者的动机（颂主、贬敌、猎奇）；这一方法使他从'相信编年史的历史学家'变成'检验编年史的历史学家'——比兰克'如实直书'早五百年，比吉本式怀疑早四百年
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology / the subject of the Muqaddimah's opening: received chronicles swarm with incredible reports — magnified army counts, fabulous rumours, errors copied from earlier books; his canonic of testing: first distinguish 'apparent meaning' (what the text literally says) from 'inner meaning' (whether the report could be true under the political, social and psychological conditions of its time); second, the measure of general possibility — an isolated report violating the general nature of things (a city wall built bare-handed in one night) cannot stand, however illustrious the chain of transmission; third, examine the motives of transmitters and recorders (flattery of patrons, slander of foes, appetite for marvels); by this he passed from a historian who believes chronicles to one who tests them — five hundred years before Ranke's 'wie es eigentlich gewesen', four hundred before Gibbonian doubt
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第一章：'历史学表面的可信与内在的荒诞'——史料批判的纲领
modes.key_quote_zh: 表面意义可信不等于内在可能——孤例若违反事物的普遍可能性，传述链再显赫也不可采信。
modes.key_quote_en: Apparent credibility is not inner possibility — an isolated report against the general nature of things cannot stand, whatever the lustre of its transmission.
key_concepts: 表面/内在意义之辨（文本说了什么 vs 在其时代条件下是否可能）
apparent versus inner meaning (what the text says versus what was possible in its conditions)
普遍可能性尺（以自然与社会的一般规律为检验基准——反常孤例不可信）
the measure of general possibility (nature and society's general laws as the test — anomalous isolates incredible)
传述动机审查（颂主、贬敌、猎奇——利益结构决定记述变形）
motive audit (flattery, slander, marvel-seeking — interest structures distort the record)
条件一致性检验（把记载放回当时的政治军事技术条件核对可行性）
consistency testing (checking reports against the political, military and technical conditions of their time)
process_zh: 先读表面意义：忠实复述文本的记载——不先入为主地改写它
问内在可能性：把记载放回其时代的政治、技术、人口条件——它可能为真吗？
查动机结构：谁传述、为谁写、会因什么受益——颂主/贬敌/猎奇各打几分
综合定谳：表面+内在+动机三项齐过才采信；单项存疑则标注存疑而不断言真伪
process_en: Read the apparent meaning first: restate the text faithfully — no presumptive rewriting
Ask inner possibility: place the report in its era's political, technical, demographic conditions — could it be true?
Audit the motives: who transmits, for whom written, what do they gain — score flattery, slander, marvel-seeking
Conclude: credit only when all three pass; where one is doubtful, mark the doubt — neither assert nor dismiss
representative_cases_zh: 阅读竞品'用户突破一亿'的通稿——按考信法三问：内在可能吗（其市场容量撑得下吗）？动机是什么（融资期通稿）？条件一致吗（其渠道覆盖支撑这个数字吗）？——结论标为'融资叙事'而非'事实'
历史博客常见'古人平均寿命三十岁'——按考信法分辨表面与内在：三十是婴儿死亡率拉低的期望值，成人实际可活五六十一——孤立的数字若违反人口学普遍可能性即须拆解
内部复盘听到'那个决定当时所有人都同意'——按考信法查动机：发言者在为自己当时的沉默开脱——'普遍同意'的记载不可采信，改为逐人核对会议纪要
representative_cases_en: Reading a rival's '100 million users' press release — three questions: inner possibility (can their market bear it)? motive (a funding-round release)? consistency (do their channels support the number)? — filed as 'fundraising narrative', not 'fact'

The internet loves 'ancient people lived to thirty' — separating apparent from inner: thirty is a life expectancy dragged down by infant mortality; adults often reached fifty or sixty — an isolated figure against demographic possibility must be decomposed

In a post-mortem someone says 'everyone agreed with the decision at the time' — auditing motives: the speaker excusing his own silence — 'universal agreement' not credited; the minutes checked person by person

modern_applications_zh: 竞品情报：'用户破亿'通稿按三问检验（内在可能/动机/条件一致）——融资叙事与事实分档归档
数据素养：'平均年消费'类数字先做内在可能性倒推（客单价×频次上限）——违反普遍可能性的表述拆解为分位数
会议复盘：'当时所有人都同意'类陈述查动机与纪要——全票通过本身违反组织决策的普遍可能性
modern_applications_en: Competitive intelligence: test '100 million users' releases by the three questions (inner possibility, motive, consistency) — file fundraising narrative apart from fact
Data literacy: run inner-possibility back-of-envelope checks on averages (price × frequency ceiling) — decompose impossible claims into percentiles
Meeting reviews: audit 'everyone agreed at the time' claims against minutes and motives — a unanimous major decision itself violates the general nature of organisational choice

modes.domain_zh: 文明差异分析/把气候、地形、物产作为群体习性与社会形态的第一因——但以'一般而论'的或然性表述
modes.domain_en: Analysis of civilisational difference / climate, terrain and resources as first causes of group temperament and social form — stated probabilistically, 'as a general rule'
modes.definition_zh: 地理社会方法论/《绪论》专论气候与地理对人群的塑造：温带与寒带、沃土与荒漠造出不同的身体、习性、习俗与制度——'人的社会条件随其所处的自然环境而异'；他的独到处在于表述方式：一切结论以'一般而论'（fi'l-ghalib，或然性）的口吻给出——承认例外、承认规律是概率性的而非命定的；这使他既避免了'地理宿命论'的独断，又保住了'环境是第一近似'的解释力——环境不决定个体命运，但决定群体习性的统计分布
modes.definition_en: Geographical-social methodology / the Muqaddimah's chapters on climate and terrain shaping peoples: temperate and frigid zones, fertile soil and desert breed different bodies, temperaments, customs and institutions — 'the conditions of human society differ with its natural environment'; his distinction lies in the mode of statement: all conclusions given as fi'l-ghalib, 'as a general rule' — exceptions admitted, laws probabilistic rather than fatal; thus he avoids the dogma of geographic determinism while keeping the explanatory force of environment as first approximation — environment does not decide individual fates, but it sets the statistical distribution of a group's habits
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第一章第二至四节：气候带、土地与食物对人群习性的塑造（'一般而论'）
modes.key_quote_zh: 环境是一般而论的第一因——它设定群体习性的统计分布，而不判决个体命运。
modes.key_quote_en: Environment the first cause as a general rule — setting the statistical distribution of group habits, never sentencing individuals.
key_concepts: 环境第一近似（气候/地形/物产解释群体习性的统计倾向）
environment as first approximation (climate, terrain, resources explaining statistical tendencies of group habits)
或然性表述（'一般而论'——规律是概率的，例外被制度性承认）
probabilistic statement ('as a general rule' — laws probabilistic, exceptions institutionally admitted)
反宿命论（环境不判决个体——群体分布不等于个人命运）
anti-fatalism (environment sentences no individual — group distribution is not personal destiny)
物产-习俗链条（从食物与气候到职业再到道德习俗的传导机制）
the resources-customs chain (from food and climate through occupation to mores — a causal mechanism)
process_zh: 列环境变量：气候、地形、物产、区位（贸易/战守）——文明差异分析先从这些硬约束出发
推传导链：环境→生计→职业结构→习俗与制度的传导路径——机制而非跳跃
以或然性陈述：结论表述为'一般而论'——同时准备例外清单
隔离个体判断：绝不把群体统计倾向用于个体评价——分布与个人分属两套命题
process_en: List environmental variables: climate, terrain, resources, position (trade or war) — start the analysis of civilisational difference from these hard constraints
Trace the causal chain: environment → livelihood → occupational structure → customs and institutions — mechanism, not leap
State probabilistically: conclusions as 'as a general rule' — with an exceptions list kept ready
Quarantine individual judgement: never apply group statistics to persons — distribution and individual belong to different propositions
representative_cases_zh: 分析'为什么硅谷出创业者、底特律出工程师'不诉诸文化优劣，而按环境法追传导链：军工采购→大公司职业结构→忠诚与稳定偏好 vs 风投密度→失败成本低→冒险偏好——一般而论成立，个体无数例外
跨国团队协作摩擦归因：按环境法先看硬约束（时区、带宽、基础设施）造成的协作习惯差异，再看文化——多数'文化冲突'实为环境约束的习俗化
产品设计的地域差异分析：按环境法从物产与气候推'使用场景分布'（热带的共享出行模式 vs 寒带的囤积式采购）——或然性陈述避免刻板印象化营销
representative_cases_en: Explaining 'Silicon Valley breeds founders, Detroit engineers' without cultural superiority claims — by the method, tracing chains: defence procurement → big-firm occupational structure → loyalty and stability preferences, versus venture density → low failure cost → risk preference — true as a general rule, with countless individual exceptions

Attributing friction in a distributed team: the method reads hard constraints first (time zones, bandwidth, infrastructure) shaping协作 habits before 'culture' — much 'cultural conflict' is environmental constraint become custom

Regional product-design analysis: from resources and climate to usage-scene distributions (tropical ride-sharing patterns versus cold-climate stock-up purchasing) — probabilistic statements keep marketing clear of stereotype

modern_applications_zh: 组织区位分析：人才偏好差异先追硬约束传导链（采购结构/风投密度/流动性）再看文化——多数'文化冲突'是环境约束的习俗化
产品设计：地域功能差异从基建与气候推演（断网率→离线默认）而非诉诸'用户偏好'——用数据持续验证
跨区管理：区域作息与流程差异先看气候与基础设施约束——政策按'一般而论'弹性设计并附例外清单
modern_applications_en: Talent-geography analysis: trace hard-constraint chains (procurement structure, VC density, liquidity) before culture — most 'cultural conflict' is environmental constraint become custom
Product design: infer regional feature differences from infrastructure and climate (outage rate → offline default) rather than 'user preference' — and verify with data
Cross-region management: read regional schedules and process differences from climate and infrastructure first — policies designed 'as a general rule' with an exceptions list

modes.domain_zh: 繁荣期诊断/识别'奢侈'从繁荣的果变成衰败的因的临界点——消费升级如何吃掉组织的战斗能力
modes.domain_en: Diagnosis of prosperity / locating the point where luxury turns from the fruit of success into the cause of decline — how consumption upgrades eat an organisation's fighting capacity
modes.definition_zh: 文明病理方法论/《绪论》的病理学：奢侈在兴起期是健康的果（战利品与税收的享受），在盛期之后变成衰败的因——它吃掉三样东西：吃掉尚武（享乐消磨冒险与纪律）、吃掉财政（奢侈的开支结构固化，寅吃卯粮）、吃掉凝聚力（奢侈使群体从同甘共苦变为地位竞争）；诊断的难点在于奢侈的症状与繁荣的症状在早期难以区分——同样的是新楼、高薪、扩张，早期是果，晚期是因；判断尺度是'奢侈是否开始需要透支未来'：用利润享受是果，用债务与抵押未来享受是因
modes.definition_en: Methodology of civilisational pathology / the Muqaddimah's pathology: luxury in the rising phase is a healthy fruit (enjoyment of spoils and taxes), after maturity it turns into a cause of decline — eating three things: the martial spirit (pleasure wears away daring and discipline), the fisc (luxury's expense structure hardens, tomorrow spent today), and cohesion (luxury turns the group from shared hardship into status competition); the diagnostic difficulty is that early symptoms of luxury are indistinguishable from symptoms of prosperity — the same new buildings, high pay, expansion: fruit at first, cause later; the test is whether luxury has begun to mortgage the future: enjoyment paid from profit is fruit; enjoyment paid from debt and pledged tomorrows is cause
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第五章、第六章：奢侈对城市与王朝的腐蚀及'必需品'与'奢侈品'的辨析
modes.key_quote_zh: 奢侈先是繁荣的果，后是衰败的因——分界线在它是否开始透支未来。
modes.key_quote_en: Luxury first the fruit of prosperity, then the cause of decline — the line drawn where it begins to mortgage the future.
key_concepts: 果转因的临界点（用利润享受为果，用债务享受为因）
the fruit-to-cause threshold (enjoyment from profit fruit; enjoyment from debt, cause)
奢侈的三重腐蚀（尚武、财政、凝聚力——各有一种可观察症状）
luxury's triple corrosion (martial spirit, fisc, cohesion — each with an observable symptom)
必需/奢侈之辨（同一消费在不同阶段身份不同——动态而非静态分类）
necessity versus luxury (the same consumption wears different guises by phase — classification dynamic, not static)
地位竞争信号（消费从功能转向攀比时凝聚力开始瓦解）
status-competition signal (when consumption turns from function to display, cohesion begins to fail)
process_zh: 审计消费结构：把组织的支出分为'能力性投入'与'身份性消费'两类
查透支信号：身份性消费是否开始由债务/融资/抵押未来供养
测三重腐蚀：冒险项目占比在降吗？开支结构固化程度？内部攀比话题占比？
定阶段并行动：果期可继续享受，因期必须压缩身份性消费回填能力性投入
process_en: Audit the consumption structure: split the organisation's spending into capability investment and status consumption
Read the overdraft signal: is status consumption now financed by debt, fundraising, mortgaged tomorrows?
Test the triple corrosion: are daring projects shrinking? is the expense structure ossifying? how much talk is status comparison?
Fix the phase and act: in the fruit phase enjoy on; in the cause phase compress status consumption to refill capability investment
representative_cases_zh: 独角兽公司搬入地标办公室、全员配最新设备后业绩下滑——按奢侈诊断法查透支信号：办公消费由新一轮融资供养（非利润）——已过果转因临界点；压缩办公与差旅回填研发投入
老牌俱乐部会员费大涨后氛围变质——按三重腐蚀测凝聚力：话题从'打球'转向'会所排场'（地位竞争信号）——限制扩张性装修、把新增收入投入教练与青少年项目以回填能力性投入
个人财务'升职后立刻换房换车'——按奢侈诊断法自检：月供占比透支了未来三年现金流即越过临界点——享受延后至能力曲线确认
representative_cases_en: A unicorn moves into a landmark office and equips everyone with the newest gear, then performance slides — the method reads the overdraft signal: office consumption financed by a fresh funding round (not profit) — past the fruit-to-cause threshold; compress facilities and travel to refill R&D

An old club raises fees and its atmosphere spoils — the triple corrosion test reads cohesion: talk shifts from 'the game' to 'the premises' (a status-competition signal); expansionary refurbishment curbed, new income routed to coaching and youth programmes — capability investment refilled

A person, promoted, at once swaps house and car — the method's self-test: instalments overdrafting three years of cash flow crosses the threshold; enjoyment deferred until the capability curve confirms

modern_applications_zh: 财务审计：把支出分为能力性投入与身份性消费——身份性消费改由债务/融资供养即越过果转因临界点
扩张治理：融资到位后先冻结身份性改造（办公/差旅升级），把资金回填研发与冒险预算
个人财务：升职后的换房换车自检月供占未来三年现金流比例——透支未来即奢侈从果变因
modern_applications_en: Financial audit: split spending into capability investment and status consumption — status consumption financed by debt or funding rounds crosses the fruit-to-cause threshold
Expansion governance: after funding lands, freeze identity renovations (offices, travel classes) first; refill R&D and the adventure budget
Personal finance: after promotion, test house and car swaps against three years of cash flow — mortgaging tomorrows turns luxury from fruit to cause

modes.domain_zh: 知识体系建构/为一门尚无名字的领域命名、划界、立公理——使实践知识升格为可累积的科学
modes.domain_en: Building knowledge systems / naming a field that has no name yet, demarcating it, laying down its axioms — raising practical knowledge into an accumulative science
modes.definition_zh: 学科建构方法论/《绪论》最深远的成就不是某个结论而是示范了一个动作：他发现传世史学没有能力回答'王朝为什么兴亡'，于是宣布需要一门新科学——'人的社会的科学'（'ilm al-'umran al-bashari），并亲手完成学科立法的三步：命名（给它一个名字使其可被指认）、划界（它与编年史/教法/哲学各自的边界）、立公理（如'人的社会是必然的''凝聚力是政权的第一条件'——不证自明的前提，规律从公理推出）；任何领域在成熟前都处于'知识有而无科学'的状态—— legislative 动作就是把散落的实践智慧组织成公理-规律-检验的体系
modes.definition_en: Methodology of disciplinary construction / the Muqaddimah's deepest achievement is not any conclusion but the demonstration of a move: finding that received historiography could not answer 'why do dynasties rise and fall', he announced the need for a new science — ilm al-'umran al-bashari, the science of human society — and executed the legislation in three steps: naming (giving it a name whereby it can be pointed to), demarcating (its boundaries against chronicles, law and philosophy), axiomatising (self-evident premises — 'human society is necessary', 'cohesion is the first condition of power' — laws deduced from axioms); every field before maturity is in the state of 'knowledge without science' — the legislative move organises scattered practical wisdom into a system of axiom, law and test
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《历史绪论》第一章第六节：'这门科学是全新的、闻所未闻的'——学科自我立法的宣言
modes.key_quote_zh: 先命名，再划界，再立公理——把'知识有而无科学'的领域升格为可累积的科学。
modes.key_quote_en: Name it first, then demarcate it, then axiomatise it — raising a field of knowledge-without-science into an accumulative science.
key_concepts: 命名即指认（给领域一个名字使其可被讨论、传承与批评）
naming as pointing (a name makes a field discussable, teachable, criticisable)
划界（与相邻学科的边界——输入什么、不回答什么）
demarcation (boundaries with neighbouring disciplines — what it takes in, what it refuses to answer)
立公理（不证自明的前提——规律从公理演绎，检验向经验回输）
axiomatising (self-evident premises — laws deduced, tested back against experience)
知识-科学之别（有智慧箴言不等于有科学——科学要求公理体系与检验程序）
knowledge versus science (maxims of wisdom are not yet science — science demands axiom system and test procedure)
process_zh: 诊断知识状态：该领域的结论是散落的箴言还是有公理-规律-检验的体系
命名：为新领域取一个可指认的名字——命名使讨论与批评成为可能
划界：明确它回答什么、不回答什么、与相邻领域的边界
立公理与检验：写下不证自明的前提，从公理推规律，并规定规律如何被经验检验
process_en: Diagnose the knowledge state: are the field's conclusions scattered maxims or an axiom-law-test system?
Name it: give the new field a name that can be pointed to — naming makes discussion and criticism possible
Demarcate: declare what it answers, what it refuses, where its neighbours begin
Axiomatise and test: write down the self-evident premises, deduce laws, and specify how experience tests them
representative_cases_zh: 公司内部'增长黑客'实践散落各团队——按立法法把经验升格：命名（内部增长手册）、划界（回答'为什么增长'不回答'做什么产品'）、立公理（如'留存先于获客'）——散落技巧变成可传承学科
某行业'危机公关'长期靠口口相传——按立法法整理为公理（'回应速度决定舆论半衰期'）+规律+检验（复盘每次传播曲线）——从手艺变成学科
开源治理领域同名不同义——按立法法先做划界（治理回答'决策权分配'而非'行为规范'），再立公理（'合法性问题不解决，任何规则都会被绕过'）——术语混战结束
representative_cases_en: A company's 'growth hacking' practice scattered across teams — by the legislative method, upgrade it: name (an internal growth handbook), demarcate (answers 'why growth', not 'what product'), axiomatise ('retention precedes acquisition') — scattered tricks become a teachable discipline

An industry's 'crisis PR' long a matter of hearsay — organised by the method into axioms ('response speed sets the half-life of the storm'), laws, and tests (post-mortems of every spread curve) — craft become science

In open-source governance the same words mean different things — first demarcate (governance answers 'allocation of decision rights', not 'codes of conduct'), then axiomatise ('until legitimacy is solved, every rule is bypassed') — the war of terms ends

modern_applications_zh: 内部知识管理：散落的'增长黑客/危机公关'经验按立法三步升格——命名手册、划界（回答什么不回答什么）、立公理+检验节奏
流程移植：抄别家实践先抄学科结构（公理/划界/检验）而非只抄'规律'层——缺公理与检验的照搬必然失效
术语治理：同名不同义的多团队协作先做划界与公理声明——术语混战只能由立法动作终结
modern_applications_en: Internal knowledge management: upgrade scattered 'growth hacking / crisis PR' lore by the legislative three steps — name the handbook, demarcate scope, set axioms and a testing cadence
Practice transplant: copy a discipline's structure (axioms, demarcation, tests), not just its 'laws' layer — imitation without axiom and test always fails
Terminology governance: end same-word-different-meaning muddles by demarcation and axiom statements — term wars close only by a legislative act

modes.domain_zh: 研究立场设计/在'亲历者'与'旁观者'两种身份间有意识切换——用亲历获取真材料，用旁观保住分析的独立性
modes.domain_en: Designing the stance of inquiry / conscious switching between participant and bystander — firsthand access for true material, detachment for analytic independence
modes.definition_zh: 知识生产方法论/伊本·赫勒敦的条件独一无二：他既是马格里布政治的亲历者（大臣、使节、囚徒——《绪论》的政治规律是他亲身破产、流亡、下狱的经验总结），又在写《绪论》的四年隐居中刻意抽身旁观（退居伊本·萨拉玛城堡——'远离政治、友人与干扰'）；他的方法启示是双重的：亲历给材料（没有宫廷生涯就写不出对王朝机制的直觉），旁观给结构（身在局中者看见的是人与恩怨，退后一步才看见曲线与周期）；两栖的关键是切换纪律——亲历期不假装中立，写作期不夹杂利害
modes.definition_en: Methodology of knowledge production / Ibn Khaldun's conditions were unique: he was both a participant in Maghribi politics (minister, envoy, prisoner — the Muqaddimah's political laws the distillate of his own bankruptcy, exile and imprisonment) and, in the four years of retreat writing it, a deliberate bystander (withdrawn to the castle of Ibn Salama — 'far from politics, friends and distractions'); the method's lesson is twofold: participation gives material (without the court career no intuition of dynastic mechanics could be written), detachment gives structure (from inside one sees persons and grudges; stepping back, curves and cycles); the crux is the discipline of switching — in the participant phase pretend no neutrality, in the writing phase admit no interest
modes.source_chapter: 伊本·赫勒敦《自传》：1375-1379 年退隐伊本·萨拉玛城堡著《绪论》的经历；《绪论》多处自述宫廷经验为其材料来源
modes.key_quote_zh: 亲历给材料，旁观给结构——亲历期不假装中立，写作期不夹杂利害。
modes.key_quote_en: Participation gives material, detachment gives structure — in the field admit no pretence of neutrality; at the desk admit no interest.
key_concepts: 亲历的材料价值（机制直觉只能来自内部经验——局外人看不见的真实约束）
the material value of participation (intuition of mechanics only from inside — real constraints invisible to outsiders)
旁观的结构价值（退后一步才看见曲线与周期——局中只见人与恩怨）
the structural value of detachment (curves and cycles seen only from afar — inside, only persons and grudges)
切换纪律（两个阶段各有禁令——亲历期禁中立姿态，写作期禁利害考量）
switching discipline (each phase has its prohibition — no neutrality pose in the field, no interest at the desk)
隐居的条件设计（物理隔离作为认知隔离——退居城堡四年的方法论意义）
designing the retreat (physical isolation as cognitive isolation — four years in a castle as method)
process_zh: 规划两栖周期：把研究项目显式分为'亲历期'（获取材料）与'写作期'（建构结构）——并让两者有物理间隔
亲历期禁中立：进场的目的就是获取真材料——记录自己的利害与立场而非假装客观
写作期禁利害：退场后核对每条判断是否仍受旧利益牵连——必要时请局外人复核
切换留痕：两次身份转换时写下'我知道什么、我偏向什么'的交接文档
process_en: Plan the amphibious cycle: divide the research explicitly into a participant phase (gathering material) and a writing phase (building structure) — with physical separation between them
In the field, no neutrality: you enter to get true material — record your own stakes and stance rather than feigning objectivity
At the desk, no interest: after exit, check every judgement for entanglement with old stakes — have an outsider re-check where needed
Leave a trace of each switch: at every change of role write a handover of 'what I know, what I lean toward'
representative_cases_zh: 记者转型写行业史的成败对比：成功者在离开行业一年后动笔（旁观给结构），且在书中明示自己曾任职的立场（亲历留痕）——两栖纪律完整
离职员工写公司复盘——按两栖法：亲历期材料最真（离职面试），但写作期必须给情绪降温窗口（半年）并请在职者核对事实性断言
研究员做用户访谈——按两栖法切换：访谈时全身心代入不纠正对方（亲历），分析时退出情境只看语料（旁观）——忌讳边聊边下结论
representative_cases_en: The contrast between journalists-turned-historians: the successful one begins writing a year after leaving the industry (detachment gives structure) and discloses in the book the posts he once held (participation on record) — the amphibious discipline complete

A departed employee writes a company post-mortem — by the method: participant-phase material is truest (exit interviews), but the writing phase needs a cooling window (six months) and fact-checks by those still inside

A researcher running user interviews — switching by the method: full immersion during the interview, no corrections (participant); at analysis, stepping out to the transcript alone (bystander) — never concluding mid-conversation

托克维尔

modern_applications_zh: 研究报告：驻场/深耕后的写作设冷却窗口与局外人盲审——亲历期不假装中立，写作期不夹杂利害
用户研究：访谈期全身心代入不引导，分析期只看语料——'边聊边断'用切换纪律取代
离职复盘：离职员工的公司复盘给情绪降温窗口（半年）并请在职者核对事实性断言——亲历真材料+旁观独立结论
modern_applications_en: Research reporting: after deep immersion, set a cooling window and an outsider's blind review — in the field admit no pretence of neutrality; at the desk admit no interest
User research: full immersion in interviews without steering; analysis from transcripts alone — 'concluding mid-chat' replaced by switching discipline
Exit post-mortems: departed employees' accounts get a cooling window (six months) and fact-checks by those still inside — the participant's true material plus the bystander's independent conclusions
